id: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (2016)
title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
tagline: Jacob bakes. Queenie cooks. You eat.
about: A magizoologist arrives in 1926 New York and his case of magical creatures gets loose.
cue: Serve dessert when Queenie magics up the apple strudel.

animal shapes with cutters or a knife.Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle generously with cinnamon sugar.Bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.Cool on a rack and arrange like a bakery window.Smoked paprika devilled eggsDevilled eggs with smoked paprikaHow to make it8 eggs1/4 cup mayonnaise1 tbsp Dijon mustard1 tsp smoked paprika300g green olivesBoil the eggs until hard.Cool and peel.Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with mayonnaise and Dijon until smooth.Pipe back into the whites and dust with smoked paprika.Set out on the bar beside a bowl of green olives.Niffler's golden gruyère gougèresThe niffler raiding the bank for anything shinyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp golden choux puffs made with gruyère and a pinch of cayenne, baked until hollow and shiny, piled up like a niffler's stash.Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil.Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until the dough leaves the sides.Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy.Stir in 120g grated gruyère and a pinch of cayenne.Pipe walnut-size balls onto lined trays, top with a little more cheese and bake at 200°C for creamsalt, to tasteBoil the potatoes until tender, then mash and mix with the cheddar, seasoning with salt to taste.Slice the onions.Fill the wrappers and pinch closed.Boil the pierogi in batches until they float.Fry in butter with the onion until golden on both sides.Serve with sour cream.1926 New York beef pot roastThe Goldstein sisters' flatHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck browned and braised at 160°C for 3 hours with onion, carrot and stock, potatoes added for the last hour.Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and brown all over in a heavy pot.Add 2 quartered onions, 3 carrots in chunks, 2 garlic cloves, 2 thyme sprigs, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 500ml beef stock.Cover and braise at 160°C for 2 hours.Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more until everything is
